method: Whole original main.py loaded unchanged by runpy, no fake functions or decoding adapters. File-write controls confined to owned TemporaryDirectory. Original upstream unittest module executed unchanged in subprocess. No streaming signals, GUI or external services.

upstream_suite.limitations: File operation tests use dry_run and do not inspect actual output bytes; streaming demo does not invoke the processor.

limits: These are text-line normalization/publication controls, not image/video duplicate detection or local library end-to-end evidence.
